mapping.scan: clockwise ray from center to image edge
mapping.pitch: Higher pitch near the center, lower pitch toward the edge; red uses one octave below the base scale, blue one octave above.
mapping.hue: HSV hue blends red (0 degrees), green (120 degrees), and blue (240 degrees) instruments around the hue circle.
mapping.saturation: Colored layer strength equals HSV saturation; the neutral layer gets 1 minus saturation.
mapping.volume: Brightness = 0.2126 R + 0.7152 G + 0.0722 B; each voice volume = brightness times layer strength divided by 12.
mapping.normalization: Fixed feature bounds; no per-image contrast stretching. Audio playback is peak-normalized by default; use normalize=false for fixed gain.
mapping.alpha: Composited onto black; fully transparent pixels are silent.
mapping.scope: Entire image including any labels, legends, land, and borders; no automatic map segmentation.
mapping.meaning: Sonification of rendered pixels, not measured Earth-science quantities. Scan time is not observation time. STRAUSS Objects sustain each row tone while its volume interpolates between columns.
